adds.title: X-Men (2000)
adds.text: Scott, one of Xavier's first students, leads his X-Men, bringing Logan and Rogue to the school and taking the team to Liberty Island after Xavier falls into a coma.
adds.on_a_card_about_b: One of Xavier's first students, now leading his X-Men.
adds.on_b_card_about_a: Taught Scott to control his power and sends his X-Men out.
adds.evidence: X-Men (2000): Cyclops and Storm save Logan and Rogue from Sabretooth and bring them to Xavier's school; Xavier says Cyclops, Storm and Jean were some of his first students; after Xavier's coma the X-Men go to Liberty Island, where Cyclops subdues Magneto.

adds.title: X-Men (2000)
adds.text: Kitty is a student in Xavier's physics class. When he dismisses the class, she says goodbye to him and phases out through the door.
adds.on_a_card_about_b: A student in Xavier's physics class.
adds.on_b_card_about_a: Teaches Kitty physics at his school.
adds.evidence: X-Men (2000): during Professor X's physics class Logan barges in; when the class is dismissed Kitty goes back for her bag, greets the Professor and phases through the door. Kind mentor (teacher and student) rather than the later ally stage; the ally stage in Days of Future Past would follow it.

adds.title: X-Men (2000)
adds.text: At the top of the Statue of Liberty, Magneto binds Jean and the other X-Men in metal. Jean tells him Senator Kelly is dead, but he ignores her and goes on with his plan.
adds.on_a_card_about_b: An X-Man Magneto binds in metal at the Statue of Liberty.
adds.on_b_card_about_a: Binds Jean in metal at the Statue of Liberty.
adds.evidence: X-Men (2000), Liberty Island: Magneto binds Jean, Scott, Storm and Logan with metal restraints, placing Jean opposite Scott; Jean tells him Kelly is dead and he ignores her. The later Last Stand stage (ally) is a clear turn when he recruits the Phoenix.

adds.title: Thor: Ragnarok
adds.text: Heimdall lets Thor see Asgard through his eyes from Sakaar and tells him to take the largest gateway home. When Thor fears what he has done, Heimdall tells him Asgard is not a place but a people.
adds.on_a_card_about_b: Heimdall's friend, who sees through his eyes to find the way home.
adds.on_b_card_about_a: Guides Thor home from Sakaar and saves Asgard's people.
adds.evidence: Thor: Ragnarok: imprisoned on Sakaar, Thor reaches Heimdall and sees Asgard through his eyes; Heimdall tells him to take the largest gateway; they fight together at the Bifrost and, aboard the Statesman, Heimdall says 'Asgard is not a place, it's a people.'

adds.title: Thor: Ragnarok
adds.text: Strange pulls Thor into the Sanctum, tells him where Odin is, and sends him and Loki to Norway to find their father.
adds.on_a_card_about_b: The sorcerer who sends Thor and Loki to Odin in Norway.
adds.on_b_card_about_a: Strange sends him and Loki to find Odin in Norway.
adds.evidence: Thor: Ragnarok: 'With directions from Stephen Strange, they find Odin in Norway.' This is the full version of the scene the existing Doctor Strange stage already covers.

owner_calls.question: The Sanctum scene appears both as the Doctor Strange end scene (the existing stage) and in full in Thor: Ragnarok. Add the Ragnarok stage so Ragnarok alone shows the tie, or rely on the Doctor Strange stage only?
options: Keep only the Doctor Strange stage
